name: volatility-diagnosis-v1
question: Why is simulated 1-minute volatility 3.5-4.4x the historical BTCUSDT 1-minute volatility (~4.0-4.5 bps)?
design: paired seeds 501-503, 3600 s runs, one factor changed at a time from the default population; the latent fundamental column of the per-second series is used as a direct measurement of the exogenous input

H-vol-shock.claim: the exogenous fundamental process (GBM 0.6/yr + news jumps 6/h x 0.4%) alone is already ~3x too volatile and the price tracks it
H-vol-shock.prediction: fundamental 1m std >= 10 bps; mid 1m std / fundamental 1m std in [0.7, 1.5]; removing news jumps and setting GBM vol to 0.33/yr cuts mid 1m std by >= 50%
H-vol-shock.refuted_if: fundamental 1m std < 6 bps, or mid std falls by < 25% when the fundamental is made realistic

H-vol-micro.claim: endogenous microstructure noise (quote refresh, bid-ask bounce, thin depth) sets a floor above historical volatility
H-vol-micro.prediction: with a FROZEN fundamental (vol 0, no news), mid 1m std stays > 4 bps

H-vol-leverage.prediction: removing leveraged agents lowers mid 1m std by >= 15%

H-vol-herding.claim: correlated decisions through the social network add volatility
H-vol-herding.prediction: social network + imitation off lowers mid 1m std by >= 15%

H-vol-time.claim: time scaling error: one simulated minute is not 60 virtual seconds or bars are mis-sampled
H-vol-time.prediction: a code/unit check finds a mismatch
H-vol-time.refuted_if: series sampled every 1000 ms and minute bars taken every 60 samples

H-vol-numeric.claim: mid computation artefacts (integer ticks, one-sided books) inflate measured volatility
H-vol-numeric.prediction: one-sided-book seconds > 5% or mid-vs-microprice volatility differs by > 20%

properties_compared: price impact (1m return on signed volume)
historical_reference: TRAIN days only (5 days of 1m BTCUSDT); spread/impact/order flow have no historical counterpart in our data (OHLCV only)
stopping_rule: 3 seeds per condition; no extra seeds added after seeing results

amendment_v2.after_results: v1 (shock spec supported, micro floor refuted, leverage/herding amplify)
amendment_v2.question: why is mid 1m vol ~1.8x the realistic fundamental's 1m vol?

H-amp-belief.claim: value/whale private belief noise (AR(1), 20/10 bps) makes informed traders churn and moves the price
H-amp-belief.prediction: belief noise -> 2/1 bps cuts mid 1m std by >= 25%

H-amp-momentum.prediction: momentum population 0 cuts mid 1m std by >= 20%

H-amp-noise.claim: retail noise flow (64 agents, market orders) adds variance
H-amp-noise.prediction: noise population 0 cuts mid 1m std by >= 20%
